title: Seeded Perilla Confit Toast
description: A flavorful and nutritious French-inspired toast topped with perilla seeds and confit.

ingredients.name: Perilla seeds
ingredients.notes: available at most health food stores

instructions: Slice the bread into 1-inch thick rounds and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread and sprinkle with salt.
Toast the bread in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Spread the confit over the toasted bread, leaving a small border around the edges.
Sprinkle the perilla seeds over the confit.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
